title: Russell US Style indexes — conditional MONTH-end capping check effective at the open of 2027-05-28 (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2027-05-25 close), the last reset that can bind the June quarter-end test
source: EST: owner-published standing rule, re-fetched and re-derived by THIS session (2026-09-09) rather than inherited from the proposal, and still DISPUTED BETWEEN TWO OWNER DOCUMENTS. FTSE Russell, "Capping Methodology Guide", v5.4, September 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes, 62 content streams inflated and text-extracted in-session 2026-09-09 -- byte, stream and version all reproduce the four sibling ledgers, so the guide has NOT been revised since 2026-09-08): every Russell US Style row in section 4.8.6 reads frequency "Monthly", price date "T-3", effective date "Last business day of each month" (footnote 3), trigger "No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index", scheme "Rule 4.2/RIC 22.5/45". Section 4.8.4 read verbatim in-session: "If none of the applicable trigger thresholds are breached, no change is implemented as a result of the additional capping check" -- so this check is a TEST, not an unconditional reset. AGAINST THAT, FTSE Russell's "Frequently Asked Questions -- Russell US Equity Indexes", July 2026 (ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 streams, re-fetched the same session) still says verbatim "The review is conducted quarterly (March, June, September, and December)". If the FAQ governs, this event does not exist. THE 2027 DATE IS RULE-DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED, and the derivation was re-run mechanically this session rather than accepted: the last business day of May 2027 is Friday 2027-05-28 because Memorial Day falls on Monday 2027-05-31, which this repo's own src/domain/market-calendar.ts carries as a full closure and which the calendar already tracks as memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31; walking T-3 back in business days over the same 2027 holiday set returns Tuesday 2027-05-25. The identical walk reproduces the owner's published 2026 quarter-end cut-offs and the siblings' derived 2027-03-25, 2027-04-27 and 2027-06-25 dates, which is the cross-check that the calendar used here is the right one. Filed estimate because a lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, because the confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for an index owner's own published methodology, and because the owner's own two documents disagree about whether the check happens at all. Initial research 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-09 by this id's own initial research; it previously existed only as proposals/russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2027-05-28.from-russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-06-30.json, which was read in full first. THE PROPOSER'S FILING RATIONALE WAS TESTED AND HOLDS, WITH ONE CORRECTION. It filed this instance as the ONE deliberate exception to the December sibling's decline of the whole 2027 month-end class, on the ground that it is "THE DISCRIMINATING INPUT" to russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-06-30 -- the only quarter whose style capping review takes effect AFTER its own test's price date, so the June test's binding reset is whatever check was last actually in force. Measured this session on 1,281 daily bars (2021-08-02 to 2026-09-08), the monthly-vs-quarterly fork prices the June test at 17.32% vs 44.24%, a 26.92pp spread, and THIS check carries 14.99pp of it -- the larger half. SUPPORTED. THE CORRECTION: the June lane declined the 2027-04-27 April month-end check on the ground that it "changes no number here -- the 05-25 check resets after it either way". That is the reset fallacy this family already refuted (russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2026-11-30, headline 1, citing section 4.8.4): a conditional check resets only in the ~20% of paths where it fires. Measured, the April check is worth 11.93pp to the June test and 16.45pp to THIS event's own breach probability (36.73% -> 20.28%). It is therefore proposed as proposals/russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2027-04-27.from-russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2027-05-28.json in the same PR. This entry's OWN geometry: the last UNCONDITIONAL reset before the 2027-05-25 test is the March 2027 quarterly Russell US Style capping review (cut-off 2027-03-10), 53 trading sessions out, with conditional checks at 2027-03-25 (session 11) and 2027-04-27 (session 33); path-simulated breach probability 20.28% (IWY) and 19.63% (IWF), regime range 10-20%. Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY on the family's measured grounds: no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (0 hits in trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md, re-grepped 2026-09-09), and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta. Estimate on a disputed rule with a conditional trigger; nothing here licenses an entry.
